summary: Turns numeric character references back into characters.
description: Decimal (`<`) and hexadecimal (`<`) references are decoded. Named entities are **not**: `"&"` comes back unchanged, because this is the inverse of `encodeHtml`, which only ever emits numeric references.

params.value: The string to convert. It must not be empty.

throws.EmptyStringException: the value is not a string, or is empty.
